text:
laura: noticed two customers got invoices yesterday with GPU usage missing (only storage + support lines). saw refund/reauthorize for one. anyone tracking?
jon: yup. the nightly render produced invoices with no compute lines for sku aliases 'g-p100' and 'g-p40'. looks like sku_resolution returned empty for some exported usage rows.
sam: can you paste the render log tail?
laura: log snippet from invoice-renderer:```
2026-03-23T02:12:05Z ERROR sku_resolver: resolved_rates empty for alias=g-p100 account=nimbus-9 usage_row_id=usr_9ab4
2026-03-23T02:12:05Z INFO invoice_builder: skipping line family=compute due to no_rates_found
```
rachel: finance-bot also flagged a duplicate charge when the retry path re-sent invoice to the payments vendor after a transient 502. vendor accepted both, created two invoice records. :grimacing:
finance-bot: Automated Alert: Duplicate payment intent created for invoice INV-2026-0323-2044 and INV-2026-0323-2044-duplicate for customer nimbus-9. Manual reconcile required.
jon: root cause looks like a mapping prune we shipped last week to normalize old aliases. that change removed some aliases used by the legacy usage-export pipeline.
sam: immediate mitigation: restore the alias mapping, run a targeted re-render for affected accounts, and run the sender with --idempotency-key set (we currently default to nil if a legacy export hits new path). command I ran locally: `./invoice_send --date 2026-03-23 --account nimbus-9 --regen --idempotency-key=reconcile-0323`
laura: thanks. CS escalated with nimbus; they were double-charged and had to dispute one. we'll offer a one-time credit and apology. rachel, can you coordinate message?
rachel: on it. will draft templated note and attach corrected invoice PDF when ready.
jon: longer term: add a preflight validation in invoice-renderer to fail the batch if any expected family (compute, storage, support) has zero lines for accounts that had usage in that family. also add a schema check on usage-export to ensure alias present. opening ticket now.
sam: also we should make sender idempotent by default. relying on a passed-in idempotency key is brittle. i'll make a small PR to enforce idempotency header generation from invoice_id + date.
laura: affected invoices for audit: INV-2026-0323-2044 (missing compute), INV-2026-0323-2044-duplicate (duplicate charge), INV-2026-0323-2050 (rounded total mismatch after regen). listing in the support ticket.
jon: ETA to revert mapping + regen: ~2.5h. I'll post progress here.
laura: please also include a short blurb for execs summarizing impact and remediation when you close the ticket. thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
